invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null Iterator either from a parent call or a newly created one.
fileId is used directly in log messages and as a map key, so must be non-null.
partitionPath is passed into constructors and parent calls, so it must be non-null.
recordItr is used in both branches and passed to other methods, so it must be non-null.
Each element of the Iterator should be a non-null List<WriteStatus>.
